description: Android Application class for initializing app components, including dependency injection with Koin, setting up notification channels, configuring crash reporting with ACRA, and scheduling background workers.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Custom Application class for initializing app-wide components, dependency injection, notifications, crash reporting, and background tasks.

methods.name: newImageLoader
methods.description: Creates and configures an ImageLoader with crossfade, memory cache, disk cache, and component decoders based on SDK version.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes dependency injection with Koin, creates notification channels, and enqueues background workers.

methods.name: attachBaseContext
methods.description: Initializes ACRA crash reporting with specific configuration and disables error reporting.

methods.name: createNotificationChannels
methods.description: Creates notification channels for Android O and above.

methods.name: enqueueWorkers
methods.description: Schedules periodic background workers for cleaning and synchronization tasks.

methods.name: enableStrictMode
methods.description: Enables strict mode policies for debugging, including network detection and leaked object detection.
